mentions.name: sdf2stl
mentions.description: A web tool for designing 3D objects with mathematics using signed distance functions (SDF), built in the same language as the Shadertoy SDF community, and exporting models to STL for 3D printing. It can produce shapes that are impossible to create with CAD, CSG, sculpting, or mesh-based tools.
mentions.problem: Creating 3D models that are impossible to create with CAD, CSG, sculpting, or mesh-based tools.
mentions.audience: A tool for people who want to design 3D-printable objects with math.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I made sdf2stl.saej.in

You can use it design 3D objects with mathematics and bring them into the real world with 3D printing.
